definitions.explanation: A person's height or stature. Composed of 背 (back, height) + 丈 (length, measure). More literary and descriptive than 身長 (しんちょう), which is the standard clinical/statistical term for height.

examples.japanese: {背丈|せたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧くらい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{背丈|せたけ}だ。
examples.english: She is about the same height as her mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{背丈|せたけ}ほど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びていて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧、⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えなかった→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The grass had grown to about my height, and I couldn't see ahead.

notes:
USAGE:
{背丈|せたけ} is used more in descriptive or narrative contexts, while ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧ is the standard term for exact height measurements (e.g., on medical forms). ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧ alone can also mean height in casual speech (⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — "tall").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背丈|せたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (to grow taller)
- {背丈|せたけ}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ (grass as tall as a person)
- {背丈|せたけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧ (suited to one's height)
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{背丈|せたけ} (the same height)
